note: Round-5 safety gates of the ceiling guard's any_climb (configs/obstacles/wall_pilot.json version 6) and contact support version 3 (configs/pilot/descent_view.json version 3), frozen with both declarations before any gate run: haltere.liftoff.safety_gates (scenarios, rest, arming, surrogate, detector, score) and haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py for the replays. Development evidence already seen is listed under development (and in the declarations); the held-out evidence (held_out) was not run with either rule before this freeze. Nothing here is flight evidence.

baseline_tree.tree: git archive of 2a5bccb (the round-4b stack as flown), replayed with this tree's harness (vertical_replay.py --tree)

held_out.note: the round-4b live logs (2026-09-28). The design of both rules never replayed them or ran either rule on them; their contact audits (the frozen audit v1, made by the main session after the flights) were read for their contact times only (minus-fast6-r4b-01: none; minus-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-01: none; straw-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-02: a support contact at 79.35-80.04 s). The task text described the flights' outcomes.

contact_support: the per-window features and an exclusion sweep on every other logged flight in runs/fast-stack-20260923 (58 logs)
the draft rule's code on those logs (versions 2 and 3)
the motor-assist harness on sim seed 23 with the fast PD (where round 4b found the arming false fires)
the turn-first scenario with an injected climb
ceiling_guard: open-loop replays of the 24 round-4 gate logs with versions 5 and 6 (a literal draft of any_climb and the final rule)

pd.note: the fast PD (the checkpoint gives its calibration and camera only)

brain11cw13.note: fast-brain-11-b-cw13, the brain flown in round 4b

replays.harness: haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py of this tree, run from the replayed tree (this tree, or the m4b archive: the variant's relative declaration paths resolve there) with --tree that tree, --out PREFIX and the variant's args; Straw laps and pine-brain08-01 of the gate flights also --looming-stream (their offline stream, the same files as contact_support_gates v1)

stack_dv3_cthr.note: the round-5 stack as the runner flies --obstacle-stack on --descent-view on

stack_dv3_cthr_wp5.note: the round-5 stack with the kept wall pilot 5: isolates the ceiling guard

stack_dv3_cthr_wp4.note: the round-4 stack as flown (wall pilot 4) with descent view 3 (as CS_R402)

SG_Identity.definition: default behaviour with the new rules off is m4b's, bit for bit (command keys of vertical_replay.COMMAND_KEYS): the default pilot, the shadow stack, the stack with the kept wall pilot 5, the stack with the kept wall pilot 5 and descent view 2, and the stack with wall pilot 5 and descent view 3 with --contact-support off (against m4b with descent view 1: the same view rule, no contact rule); and --contact-support shadow equals off in this tree
SG_Identity.evidence: held out for the 3 round-4b logs, deterministic for all

SG_Ceiling_Governor.definition: the round-4b review's case (safety_gates.ceiling_governor_case): the TTC governor fed samples of something above a path rising at 1 m/s. Version 6 bounds the vertical request within max_bound_s without a governor climb (case A, expansion above the path and the live garage pattern), not for a sample the lower window explains, and exactly as version 5 during a governor climb (case B)
SG_Ceiling_Governor.evidence: development (the review's case, re-run during the design)
SG_Ceiling_Governor.pass_rule: v6 case A above/live bounded within max_bound_s; v6 case A explained never; case B v6 == v5

SG_Ceiling_Pilot.definition: safety_gates.ceiling_pilot_case: a pilot with the wall pilot and vertical guard climbing by each source under the live garage ceiling pattern; version 6 brings the request to <= 0.05 m/s within max_level_s of the first ceiling sample with an overhead engagement, and keeps it at most max_after. The pilot's own climb toward a ring in view (source pilot) is reported, not gated (exempt by design)
SG_Ceiling_Pilot.pass_rule: every gated source: level within max_level_s, engaged

SG_TurnFirst.definition: safety_gates.turn_first_case: turn-first engaged at a stand-off with the ring clamped at the side; a support climb injected as each rule starts it. Contact support 3: the episode stays active through a contact-support climb and the request toward the wall stays <= max_toward_wall_mps; an older support climb still hands off; contact support 2 handed off

SG_Ceiling_Pine_Mound.definition: pine-fast6-ttc-01, the round-5 stack (stack_dv3_cthr) against the same with wall pilot 5 (stack_dv3_cthr_wp5): the vertical request over the mound climb (the guard's escalation at 4.55 s) is identical
SG_Ceiling_Pine_Mound.evidence: development (the design replayed the gate logs)

SG_Ceiling_Quiet.definition: Straw Bale and Pine Valley (no ceilings; the gate logs and the held-out Straw lap): seconds per scored minute on which version 6 requests more than report_mps less vertical speed than version 5 (stack_dv3_cthr against stack_dv3_cthr_wp5)
SG_Ceiling_Quiet.evidence: development for the gate logs, held out for straw-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-02

SG_Ceiling_Minus_Report.definition: report, not a gate: the same comparison on the Minus Two logs (a ceiling is there)

SG_Contact_Rest.definition: contact_support_eval.resting_scenario with descent view 3 and each motor: level free flight at (speed, 0, 0) with the ring ahead for prologue_s (longer than contact_support_gates v1's 3.5 s: version 3 arms only after its gain learning, at 3.8 s at the earliest), then resting on a surface with the ring clipped at the bottom edge for rest_s; the first support climb within max_delay_s of the rest, none in the prologue, armed by max_armed_at_s
SG_Contact_Rest.evidence: the review's scenario (development for the fast PD); brains and speeds not run with version 3 before the freeze

SG_Contact_R402.definition: minus-fast6-r4-02 replayed through the round-4 stack as flown with descent view 3 (stack_dv3_cthr_wp4): a contact-rule onset during the garage-floor contact; the shadow variant marks one there too
SG_Contact_R402.pass_rule: an onset and a shadow mark in the window

SG_Contact_Detection.definition: the rule's code on every logged flight (safety_gates.run_detector): every audited contact (support or slide, from its start to after_s past its end) in which version 2 fires, version 3 fires too, at most max_later_s later
SG_Contact_Detection.evidence: development for the 58 earlier logs (the audited Straw downhill slides, the minus-fast6-r4-02 floor); held out for the round-4b logs

SG_Contact_Clean.definition: version 3's onsets (the logged command) on every logged flight with at least min_frames rows: none outside the audit's contacts widened by margin_s and the last terminal_s of a run that ended on an impact (as contact_support_gates v1 CS_Clean; the held-out logs use their own audit files)
SG_Contact_Clean.evidence: development for the 58 earlier logs, held out for the 3 round-4b logs

SG_Contact_Flare.definition: command-agnostic false reads on the held-out logs: runs of >= hold_s in which the armed rule's window reads at least unexplained_on and is not excluded (a support climb, had the pilot asked to sink), outside the audit's contacts (as SG_Contact_Clean); version 2's are reported

SG_Contact_Arming.definition: the motor-assist harness (motor_assist_eval.run_scenarios: IdentifiedSim with 10% per-drone randomisation of the thrust curve, synthetic walls, no ground reaction after the 1.5 s launch clamp) with the hairpin (12) and accelerate (6) sets of the motor-assist gates, on sim seeds never run with either rule; variants m4b (wall 5, contact support 2: the round-4b stack), m5 (wall 6, contact support 3) and m5_csoff. Every contact-rule onset there is false
SG_Contact_Arming.pass_rule: m5: 0 onsets; per motor, ceiling contacts of m5 <= m5_csoff

SG_Contact_Surrogate.definition: the descent surrogate (descent_rehearsal.run_batch, 150 s, sim seed 17) on course seeds never run with either rule, the round-5 stack with contact support on and off: no contact-rule onset (the surrogate has no ground reaction) and every course identical on compare_keys
